blindSummary: The country-level dossier's assessment applies to this state/province without material local variation; the sources below document the national framework in force here.
blindSourceSummaries: A foreign home ministry's country policy and information note on sexual orientation, gender identity and expression (June 2025): assesses that LGBT+ people outside a conflict-affected conservative region do not face a real risk from the state solely for sexual orientation, but trans people and active LGBT+ advocates are likely to face treatment amounting to persecution; at least 139 people were impacted by anti-LGBT+ laws 2022-2024 (anti-propaganda-law convictions, detentions, 'extremism' prosecutions, fines and imprisonment).

NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (automated access blocked by the site); the underlying travel advisory from a foreign government for this country warns all travellers regardless of personal characteristic (wrongful detention, arbitrary law enforcement) and notes foreigners found guilty under an anti-propaganda law face arrest, up to 15 days' detention and deportation.

A human-rights organisation news report (30 June 2025) on the rising toll of LGBT 'extremism' designations: courts have issued over 100 convictions for participation in the designated LGBT organisation or displaying its alleged symbols, and authorities are weaponising the justice system to enforce it.
